definitions.explanation: A form of classical Japanese musical drama.
The capacity to do something well.

examples.japanese: {能|のう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}する→鑑賞する：14516_kanshou⟧。

examples.english: I went to see Noh in Kyoto.
A skilled hawk hides its talons. (Still waters run deep)
I was told I have no talent.

notes:
{能|のう} has two distinct meanings: Noh theater (a traditional art form) and ability/talent.

SENSE 1 — NOH THEATER:
A classical Japanese performing art combining dance, music, and drama, dating back to the 14th century. Performers wear distinctive masks and elaborate costumes.
- ⟦{能楽|のうがく}→能楽：14065_nougaku⟧: Noh theater (formal term)
- ⟦{能面|のうめん}→能面：27782_noumen⟧: Noh mask
- ⟦{能舞台|のうぶたい}→能舞台：27783_noubutai⟧: Noh stage
- ⟦{能楽堂|のうがくどう}→能楽堂：noentry⟧: Noh theater building

SENSE 2 — ABILITY/TALENT:
Mainly appears in compounds and set phrases rather than standalone.
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: ability, capability
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: talent
- ⟦{無能|むのう}→無能：13476_munou⟧: incompetent, useless
- {能|のう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack ability

PROVERB:
{能|のう}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ — a capable hawk hides its talons (talented people don't show off; similar to "still waters run deep").
